title: Sunflower typographic editorial
reference_style: Sky-blue poster, oversized dimensional lettering, torn-paper collage and sunflower portrait.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Playful botanical fashion poster with oversized dimensional typography and a cut-paper collage aesthetic.

subject.type: Young woman in a waist-up fashion portrait
subject.pose: Seated or leaning sideways across the lower-left foreground, head turned gently down and toward the side
subject.wardrobe: White cotton blouse with delicate tiny floral print, gathered neckline and short puff sleeves
subject.hair: Long dark hair, loose and naturally windswept

composition.layout: Oversized black dimensional display lettering occupies the center and right, portrait overlaps the lettering in the lower half
composition.collage_elements: Cream torn-paper pieces, small peach paper tabs and large yellow sunflowers clustered behind the subject
composition.depth: Layered cut-outs with subtle drop shadows and clear foreground-background separation

typography.headline: SUNFLOWER
typography.style: Huge black inflated or glossy 3D display letters with cream offset extrusion and thin edge highlights
typography.placement: Narrow vertical condensed black type beside the headline
typography.microcopy: Tiny editorial labels near the outer margins
typography.legibility: Keep headline forms bold and readable; preserve clean letter contours

lighting.palette: Cyan, sunflower yellow, cream, peach, black and natural skin tones

post_processing.texture: Scanned paper grain, botanical cut-outs, slight print softness

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No extra limbs, distorted hands, duplicated facial features, illegible typography, watermarks, brand logos, cluttered collage, harsh flash.
